newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady-up $0.50 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady-up $0.50 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to $0.50 higher, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade light to moderate. Demand moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings current.
